slides.headline: “three planets are moving *backwards* right now”
slides.dek: mercury, mars and jupiter. half of that is true

slides.headline: “retrograde planets actually move backwards”
slides.body: true that mercury, mars and jupiter are all retrograde this week. not true that they reverse. every planet keeps circling the sun the same way. retrograde is what it looks like from here.

slides.headline: think of passing a slower car: it seems to *drift back*
slides.body: earth is overtaking mars and jupiter on the inside, so they appear to slide backwards against the stars. mercury, inside our orbit, does the same as it laps us.

slides.headline: a retrograde reads as a *review*, not a punishment
slides.body: astrologers read retrograde stretches as time to revisit: old plans, old drafts, old people. nothing is cursed. some things just want a second pass.

slides.headline: the planets aren't backing up. *you* can, a little.
slides.body: say the honest thing on the second try. save this.
